name: OnlineCheckYourServer
description: This is a simple container that will check if a domain name or IP address is pingable and send you a message with Pushover if it goes offline. You can install it on your machine to get notified with Pushover if a site goes down, or you can install it on a remote machine to ping your server and get a notification if it's not reachable.

variables.name: Host
variables.description: IP or Domainname to ping goes here.

variables.name: Ping Interval
variables.description: Interval in wich the Host is pinged (in seconds).

variables.name: Ping Timeout
variables.description: Time that the Host has to answer the ping request (in seconds).

variables.name: Retry after Fail
variables.description: Time to wait to retry it after the ping fails (in seconds).

variables.name: Pushover Priority
variables.description: Customize the Pushover Priority ('-2': Lowest priority | '-1': Low Priority | '0': Normal Priority | '1': High Priority | '2': Emergency Priority - without quotes)
